purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Kisaran

queries.query: Kisaran Indonesia official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Asahan ATR BPN
queries.result: First-party discovery identified ATR/BPN BHUMI and ATLAS, including the published Bidang Tanah layer. Official local Asahan evidence identified the Asahan Land Office (Kantor Pertanahan ATR/BPN Asahan) in land-mapping coordination, but no Kisaran-specific open parcel download was found.

queries.query: Kisaran peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN Asahan GIS
queries.result: Indonesian-language first-party discovery found BHUMI/ATLAS and an Asahan local-government page documenting coordination with ATR/BPN Asahan on land-value mapping. The Asahan geoportal was reachable only to a Cloudflare challenge page; no challenge was solved or bypassed.

registryEvidence.custodian: Kementerian ATR/BPN; local Kantor Pertanahan ATR/BPN Kabupaten Asahan
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The Asahan government page names coordination with ATR/BPN Asahan for land-value mapping covering Kisaran Timur and Kisaran Barat. This evidences a local land-information custodian, not open citywide cadastral geometry access.

officialSources.observation: Current ATR/BPN ATLAS catalog was retrieved and describes itself as the geospatial data portal; its catalog exposes a published Bidang Tanah layer.
BHUMI help page identifies the interactive map as integrated with the ATR/BPN ATLAS geoportal.
Official Asahan Bappenda page documents consultation with ATR/BPN Asahan and says the work began in Kisaran Timur and Kisaran Barat.

parcelDiscovery.source: ATR/BPN BHUMI / ATLAS published Bidang Tanah layer
parcelDiscovery.nativeIdField: nib (documented display field; no value retrieved)
parcelDiscovery.note: ATLAS catalog metadata exposed map_service_url /bhumigs/umum, vendor GeoServer, and layer umum:Persil with national bounds. No anonymous feature response or schema/CRS response was obtained for the exact WUP point, and no polygon is retained. The point was not shifted and was not used as an absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: 200; current public map application shell and JavaScript route retrieved.
200; current catalog JSON exposed published Bidang Tanah metadata, GeoServer service path /bhumigs/umum, layer umum:Persil, national extent, and documented display fields.
404; request was handled by the BHUMI web application rather than returning a WMS capabilities document.
404; no public WFS capabilities response was returned.
403; Cloudflare challenge page returned. No CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass attempted.
200; current ATLAS catalog page retrieved; no Kisaran-specific parcel feature response requested.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: ATR/BPN national BHUMI/ATLAS Bidang Tanah catalog and the local Asahan land-information custodian named by official local-government evidence.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Catalog metadata and local custodian evidence only; no citywide or exact-point parcel geometry was verified.

uncertainty: The published layer metadata documents parcel-related fields including NIB, rights type, area, use, and accuracy, but no values were requested or retained because no feature response was available.

The service path exposed by the current viewer did not provide anonymous WMS/WFS capabilities at the tested public URL; this may reflect proxy routing or access restrictions and is not evidence of cadastral absence.
The local Asahan geoportal returned a Cloudflare challenge; it was not bypassed.
A single exact-point request was not treated as a citywide coverage test; the WUP coordinate remains exact latitude/longitude order.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
